spec.title: Power tags

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT topic, panel, component, consumer
  FROM public."power_tags"
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1', '10P2', '10P3')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
  GROUP BY topic, panel, component, consumer
), d AS (
  SELECT topic,
    last_value(active_power_total ORDER BY timestamp) AS active_power_total,
    last_value(power_factor_total ORDER BY timestamp) AS power_factor_total,
    last_value(current_a ORDER BY timestamp) AS current_a,
    last_value(current_b ORDER BY timestamp) AS current_b,
    last_value(current_c ORDER BY timestamp) AS current_c,
    last_value(voltage_an ORDER BY timestamp) AS voltage_an,
    last_value(voltage_bn ORDER BY timestamp) AS voltage_bn,
    last_value(voltage_cn ORDER BY timestamp) AS voltage_cn,
    max(timestamp) AS ts
  FROM public."power_tags"
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1', '10P2', '10P3')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
  GROUP BY topic
)
SELECT m.panel AS "Panel", m.component AS "Component", m.consumer AS "Consumer",
  d.active_power_total AS "Active power",
  d.power_factor_total AS "Power factor",
  d.current_a AS "Ia",
  d.current_b AS "Ib",
  d.current_c AS "Ic",
  d.voltage_an AS "Van",
  d.voltage_bn AS "Vbn",
  d.voltage_cn AS "Vcn",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(d.ts) AS "Updated"
FROM m LEFT JOIN d ON d.topic = m.topic
ORDER BY 1, 2

defaults.noValue: No data in the last 5 minutes

spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. One row per power tag that published in the last 7 days, for the selected panel and consumers; a tag without data in the window shows –.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_bin('$__interval', timestamp) AS time,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS "Consumer",
  avg(active_power_total) AS "Total active power"
FROM public."power_tags"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1', '10P2', '10P3')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
  AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, topic, component, consumer
ORDER BY 2, 1 ASC

  TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01' AS time,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS "Consumer",
  last_value(active_power_total ORDER BY timestamp) AS "Total active power",
  max(timestamp) AS ts_
FROM public."power_tags"
WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1', '10P2', '10P3')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
  AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, topic, component, consumer
ORDER BY 2, 1 ASC
) q
ORDER BY 2

spec.name: live_window
spec.description: How far back the Live tabs look for the latest message, independent of the time picker. The Live tables' no-data text ('No data in the last 5 minutes') repeats this value.
